answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to anchor to a unique, human-verified ember token. The token is non-transferable and periodically re-attested via unpredictable micro-tasks. To create a fake identity, an attacker must first acquire an ember from a compromised human, then maintain that human's behavioral vine across time. The cost is not one payment but a continuous, escalating stake. Any deviation burns the stake, leaving the attacker on a barren mesa of worthless identities.
